items.html: For always it is the female that clarifies the female waters (Mayin Nukvin), as mentioned there. And also above it was explained how the Gevura of Atik is clothed in this hidden Mocha, and it is female (Nukva) relative to the Keter, in which is the Hesed of the Atik, which is male. Therefore all the judgments and the clarifications of the kings issue from it, for it is called the lamp of darkness (Buzina deKardinusa).
